frameworks.rationale: DoS attacks target service availability. PR.DS-4 requires capacity management to maintain availability.
ISO 27001 A.8.6 requires monitoring and managing resource capacity to prevent availability degradation from volumetric attacks.

DoS.remediation: Implement rate limiting, traffic scrubbing, and CDN-based DDoS mitigation.

frameworks.rationale: Reconnaissance generates anomalous network patterns. Baseline monitoring enables detection.
Systematic scanning violates expected use; monitoring activities detects such behaviour.

Reconnaissance.remediation: Block scanning IPs, deploy honeypots, enable intrusion detection signatures.

frameworks.rationale: Active exploitation requires containment to limit blast radius.
Exploitation of known CVEs indicates unpatched systems; A.8.8 mandates timely patching.

Exploits.remediation: Patch vulnerable systems immediately; enable WAF rules; review exploit signatures.

frameworks.rationale: Backdoor installation indicates compromise; an IR plan must be executed.
A backdoor constitutes a confirmed incident requiring structured response.

Backdoor.remediation: Isolate host, rotate all credentials, scan for persistence, reimage if necessary.

frameworks.rationale: Shellcode execution exploits unmanaged software flaws.

frameworks.control_name: Installation of software on operational systems
frameworks.rationale: Shellcode attempts to execute unauthorised code; control over software installation limits exposure.

Shellcode.remediation: Enable DEP/ASLR, use EDR with memory-protection capabilities, patch affected service.

frameworks.control_name: Networks monitored to detect potential cybersecurity events
frameworks.rationale: Generic attack signatures indicate malicious probing; continuous monitoring is required.

Generic.remediation: Review IDS/IPS rules; enhance network visibility and logging.

frameworks.rationale: Fuzzing generates high volumes of anomalous requests; robust logging enables detection.
Fuzzing targets input-handling weaknesses; secure development reduces attack surface.

Fuzzers.remediation: Implement input validation and rate limiting on all public-facing services.

frameworks.rationale: Analysis-category attacks probe for vulnerabilities; RA-1 mandates proactive identification.

Analysis.remediation: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments; restrict exposed services.

frameworks.control_name: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access
frameworks.rationale: Worms propagate via lateral movement; network segmentation limits spread.
Network segmentation restricts worm propagation across segments.

Worms.remediation: Segment networks, patch propagation vectors, deploy endpoint protection.

frameworks.rationale: ML-flagged events require analysis before classification.

Potential_Attack.remediation: Investigate the flagged event; escalate if confirmed malicious.

Normal.remediation: No action required for normal traffic.
